text: Happy birthday to the person who knows all my stories and still picks up the phone. Here’s to another year of ideas we’ll laugh about later.
You’ve been my favorite person since the day we met. Happy birthday, bestie: the next coffee is on me.
Happy birthday to my partner in crime, my emergency contact and my best decision.
Another year of you being the funniest person in every room. Happy birthday, friend.
I hope this year is as kind to you as you are to everyone else. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! May your plans work out, your playlists hit and your phone stay above 20%.
Thank you for every late-night talk and every “on my way.” Happy birthday to my best friend.
Growing up is optional with you, and I hope it stays that way. Happy birthday!
Here’s to the one who always says yes to dessert. I can’t wait to celebrate you.
Happy birthday to the best friend anyone could ask for. I’m lucky I never had to ask.
Happy birthday, Mom. Everything good in me started with you.
Thank you for every packed lunch, every pep talk and every “call me when you get there.” Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to the woman who taught me to be brave and kind at the same time.
Mom, I hope today feels as warm as every hug you’ve ever given me.
You make every holiday feel like home. Happy birthday, Mom. I love you.
Happy birthday to my first best friend and my forever cheerleader.
I finally understand everything you used to tell me, and you were right. Happy birthday, Mom!
May this year give back a little of everything you give everyone else. Happy birthday, Mom.
Happy birthday to the best cook, the best listener and the best mom.
No matter how old I get, I’ll always need you. Happy birthday, Mom.
Happy birthday, Dad. Thanks for teaching me how to fix things, and how to laugh when I can’t.
To the man with the best bad jokes: happy birthday. Never change.
Happy birthday to my hero, my coach and my first call when the car makes a weird noise.
Dad, I hope this year brings you as much joy as you’ve brought all of us.
Thank you for every early-morning drive and every “I’m proud of you.” Happy birthday, Dad.
Happy birthday to the best grill master on the block.
I’m still learning from you every day. Happy birthday, Dad.
Here’s to more road trips, more ball games and more of your stories. Happy birthday!
You make it look easy, and I know it isn’t. Happy birthday, Dad.
To the calmest person in every storm: happy birthday. We love you.
Happy birthday, sis. Thanks for sharing your clothes, your secrets and your fries.
You’re the friend I’d choose if we weren’t already family. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to the only person who remembers every embarrassing thing I did and loves me anyway.
Here’s to my sister, my stylist and my favorite call on the drive home.
Happy birthday! I hope your year is as bright as your laugh.
We used to fight over the remote, now we fight over the check. Happy birthday, sis.
Thanks for always having my back. Happy birthday to the best sister.
Happy birthday to the one who taught me how to dance, drive and deal with life.
May your coffee be strong and your inbox be empty. Happy birthday, sister!
Growing up with you was the best part. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday, bro. Thanks for being my built-in best friend.
You’re still annoying, and I still love you. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to my brother, my teammate and my favorite troublemaker.
Here’s to another year of inside jokes nobody else understands.
I’m proud of the person you’ve become. Happy birthday, little brother.
Happy birthday to the guy who always has my back and never my charger.
May your team win and your fantasy league go your way. Happy birthday!
Thanks for every ride, every save and every secret kept. Happy birthday, bro.
Happy birthday to the best big brother. You set the bar high.
Life is better with you around. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to the girl who made me a mom. I love you more every year.
Happy birthday, sweetheart. Watching you grow up is the greatest gift of my life.
To my daughter: you were my sunshine on day one, and you still are. Happy birthday.
You are braver, kinder and funnier than I was at your age. Happy birthday, my girl.
May this year bring you the courage to chase what you love, and people who cheer you on.
Happy birthday, darling. Wherever life takes you, home is always here.
From your first wobbly bike ride to your big dreams, I’ve loved every minute. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday to my daughter and my friend. I’m so proud of the woman you’re becoming.
God bless you on your birthday, my girl, today and every day.
Happy birthday, sweet girl. Love you always.
Happy birthday to my son, my pride and my favorite person to argue sports with.
Watching you become the man you are is the best part of my life. Happy birthday, son.
Happy birthday, buddy. You still make me laugh like nobody else.
To my son: be bold, be kind and call your mother. Happy birthday!
May this year bless you with good friends, good health and big wins.
Happy birthday to the boy who stole my heart the day he was born.
I’m proud of you every day, not just on your birthday. But today, extra.
Happy birthday, son. Whatever you build next, I’ll be cheering the loudest.
You’ll always be my little boy, even when you’re taller than me. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, son. So proud, so lucky.
Happy birthday to my favorite niece. Your auntie is so proud of you.
Happy birthday, little man! Your uncle has big plans for us this year.
Being your aunt is one of the best jobs I’ve ever had. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to my nephew, the coolest kid I know.
You make us proud to be your aunt and uncle. Happy birthday, sweetie!
Happy birthday! Remember: your aunt is always on your side, even against your parents.
May this year bring you adventures, good friends and lots of cake.
Happy birthday to my niece, who is growing up way too fast. Slow down a little!
To my nephew: keep being curious, kind and a little bit silly. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, kiddo! Spoiling you is my favorite hobby.
Happy birthday to my aunt, my second mom and my favorite person to call for advice.
Happy birthday, Uncle! Thanks for the road trips, the bad puns and the good advice.
You’re the fun aunt and the wise one too. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to my uncle, who taught me that every problem gets smaller over pancakes.
Thank you for always showing up for me. Happy birthday, Auntie.
Happy birthday to the coolest uncle in the family. Don’t tell the others.
May your birthday be full of the same love you give all of us.
Happy birthday to my aunt, whose hugs still fix everything.
Happy birthday to the uncle who always saves me a seat at the grown-ups’ table.
Happy birthday! Every family needs an aunt like you, and we got the best one.
Happy birthday to my mother-in-law. Thank you for welcoming me like family from the very first dinner.
Thank you for raising the person I love most. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to my father-in-law, a man of few words and excellent advice.
Thank you for treating me like your own, right from the start. Happy birthday, Dad.
Happy birthday to my daughter-in-law. Our family got so much better the day you joined it.
Happy birthday, son-in-law! We couldn’t have picked better ourselves.
Happy birthday to my sister-in-law, the sister I was lucky to gain.
Happy birthday to my brother-in-law, the best addition to our family.
Wishing you a birthday full of family, good food and the people who love you.
Happy birthday! I hit the jackpot with my in-laws, and you’re a big part of why.
Happy birthday! Thanks for making Mondays a little easier.
Wishing you a great birthday and a year of wins, big and small.
Happy birthday to the best desk neighbor and snack sharer.
Our meetings are better with you in them. Happy birthday!
May your calendar be light and your coffee be strong. Happy birthday!
Thank you for always being willing to help. Have a wonderful birthday.
Happy birthday to the person who makes this team feel like a team.
Cheers to you and another year of great work. Happy birthday!
Hope your birthday is as impressive as your spreadsheets.
Happy birthday from all of us. Enjoy a day with no meetings, at least in spirit.
Happy birthday! Thank you for leading with patience and good humor.
Wishing you a relaxing birthday and a great year ahead.
Happy birthday to a manager who makes the hard days easier.
Thank you for believing in our team. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! We’re lucky to learn from you.
Wishing you a birthday as good as the year you’ve helped us have.
Happy birthday from the whole team. Take the afternoon, you’ve earned it.
Thanks for always having our backs. Have a wonderful birthday.
Happy birthday to a boss who really listens. That’s rarer than you think.
Here’s to your best year yet, at work and outside it. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, my love. Every day with you is my favorite day.
You make ordinary days feel like a trip somewhere new. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to my favorite person, my safe place and my best adventure.
I’d choose you in every lifetime. Happy birthday.
Here’s to more slow mornings, more silly dances and more us. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to the one who makes me laugh until I can’t breathe.
Thank you for loving me on my messy days. Happy birthday, my love.
You’re still my favorite notification. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! I can’t wait to see what this year brings us.
Loving you is the easiest thing I do. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday to my husband, my best friend and my favorite person to come home to.
You get better every year, and so do we. Happy birthday, my love.
Happy birthday to the man who still makes me laugh at breakfast.
Thank you for choosing me, every single day. Happy birthday, husband.
You make our house a home and our life an adventure. Happy birthday!
May this year bring you rest, joy and a little time just for you.
Happy birthday to my teammate in life, in chores and in everything in between.
I’d marry you all over again, and I’d bring cake. Happy birthday!
Growing older with you is my favorite plan. Happy birthday, love.
Happy birthday, babe. Still crazy about you.
Happy birthday to my wife, the heart of our home and the love of my life.
I won the lottery the day you said yes. Happy birthday, my love.
Happy birthday to the smartest, kindest and most beautiful person I know.
Thank you for building this life with me. Happy birthday, wife.
May this year bring you as much happiness as you give our family.
Happy birthday to my best friend, my partner and my favorite dance partner.
You still give me butterflies. Happy birthday, gorgeous.
Here’s to you: the one who keeps us all together. Happy birthday!
Every year, I fall for you a little more. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday to the woman who makes everything better.
Happy birthday! You’re not getting older, you’re leveling up.
Another year wiser, or at least another year better at pretending. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! My gift to you: never telling anyone your real age.
You’re old enough to know better and young enough to do it anyway. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to someone who still can’t fold a fitted sheet. Same.
Eat the cake. Calories don’t count on your birthday; that’s science.
Happy birthday! May your Wi-Fi be strong and your group chats drama-free.
Don’t worry about getting older, worry about the candle-to-cake ratio. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Let’s celebrate like we don’t have work tomorrow. (We do.)
I’d tell you a birthday joke, but you’ve heard them all. You were there when they were invented.
Happy birthday! Have the best day.
Cheers to you!
Happy birthday, you deserve it all.
Wishing you joy today and always.
Another year of awesome. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, sunshine.
Make a wish!
Hope your day is as great as you are.
Big hugs and happy birthday.
Here’s to you!
I wish I could hug you today, so consider this one a hug in writing. Happy birthday!
Miles apart, but I’m celebrating you all day. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Save me a slice, I’m collecting it next time I visit.
Time zones can’t stop me from saying it first: happy birthday!
Raising my coffee to you from far away. Happy birthday, friend.
Distance is just a detail. Happy birthday, I miss you.
Happy birthday! Our next visit is already on my calendar.
Sending a long-distance hug and a short wish: be happy.
Even from here I can tell it’s going to be a great year for you. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Call me when the cake is gone.
Happy 18th! The world just got a new grown-up. Go easy on it.
Happy 21st birthday! Here’s to celebrating responsibly and dancing irresponsibly.
Happy 30th! Your twenties were the trailer. This is the movie.
Happy 30th birthday! You finally have it all figured out, or at least the playlist.
Happy 40th! You’ve never looked better or known yourself better.
Forty looks good on you. Happy 40th birthday!
Happy 50th! Half a century of being wonderful, and you’re just getting started.
Happy 60th birthday! Here’s to sixty years of stories and plenty more to come.
Happy 70th! Thank you for seventy years of wisdom, laughter and second helpings.
Happy 80th birthday! You make every year look like a good one.
Happy birthday to the only person who still owes me $12 from 2019. Seriously, thank you for being the friend I call first.
You’re still wrong about the ending of that movie. You’re right about almost everything else, and I’m proud of you. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday to our resident printer whisperer. Thanks for making the hard weeks lighter.
Happy birthday, Jo! Ten years ago we got lost on the way to your cousin’s wedding and found the best pie in Ohio. Here’s to more wrong turns like that.
You’re my first text with good news and my first call with bad news. I hope this year gives you plenty of the first kind.
Happy birthday! You still swear our karaoke night went well. It didn’t, and I love you anyway.
Your present is one full day of whatever you want. I’ll drive, you pick, and nobody checks email.
Happy birthday, love. You always leave me the last of the coffee, even on your worst mornings. I see it, and I love you for it.
This year we painted a kitchen, survived a road trip with your dad and still like each other. Happy birthday to my favorite teammate.
Happy birthday. I can’t wait for this year with you, starting with that cabin in October.
Still you. Always you. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday, Dad. I made your chili for friends last week and told everyone it was my recipe. Thank you for that, and for everything else.
Happy birthday to my co-defendant in the treehouse incident. Love you, even though you told Mom.
Happy birthday, Grandma. I still fold towels the way you taught me, and I think of you every single time.
Happy birthday, Linda. You made me feel like family from my very first Thanksgiving, and I’ve never forgotten it.
Happy 5th birthday, Leo! Five is the perfect age for big dinosaur facts and even bigger cake. Love, Aunt Mel.
Happy birthday, Ava! You can ride a bike with no training wheels now. I can’t wait to see what you learn at 8.
Happy 15th, Noah. You get funnier and kinder every year, which is honestly a little unfair.
Happy birthday, buddy! This card is good for one ice cream trip, any flavor you want.
Happy birthday, Marcus! Thanks for walking me through the launch checklist three times without one sigh. I owe you a very large muffin.
Happy birthday, Jen! Anyone who can finish a client call during a fire drill can handle whatever this year brings.
Happy birthday, Tom! I hope today brings cake, zero urgent emails and not a single “quick question.”
Happy birthday, Ana. Sitting next to you makes the long weeks feel shorter.
Happy birthday, Diane. Thank you for always making time for questions, even in the busiest weeks.
Happy birthday! You backed our idea at the spring review, and it meant a lot to the whole team.
Wishing you a happy birthday and a weekend with no laptop in sight.
Happy birthday, Chris! I hear you make the best cold brew on the floor. Enjoy your day.
Happy birthday! I’m glad we finally met at the fall picnic, and I hope this year treats you well.
Happy birthday from 4B! Thanks for always rescuing our packages from the rain.
Happy birthday, Dana! Game night at your place was the best kind of chaos. I hope someone else does the dishes today.
Wishing you a happy birthday and a great year ahead. Jordan Lee, Accounts
Happy birthday, Maria! Thank you for answering all my onboarding questions, even the repeat ones. Mike R., IT
Happy birthday! You covered my shifts the week my daughter was born, and I haven’t forgotten. Dee, Support
Happy birthday, Maria! Your Friday playlist got me through the March deadline. Ravi, Design
Happy belated birthday, Kim! I got the date wrong, but not the important part: you had a huge year, and you deserve a great one.
I’m late, but so is the cake I’m bringing on Saturday. Happy belated birthday!
I’ve declared your birthday a week-long event, which makes this card right on time. Happy birthday week, Sam!
Happy belated birthday, Aunt Rosa. I’m sorry I missed the day. I thought about you all week, and I’d love to call on Sunday.
Your usual order is on me this week. Thanks for always saving me a seat.
Keep Saturday night free. That’s all you get, except: wear comfortable shoes.
Nothing in a store said it right, so I made this instead.
I couldn’t bring the cake myself, so I sent it ahead. Save me a slice.
Fourteen of us, one message: we’re so glad you were born.
Every time that song we butchered at karaoke comes on, I think of you. Happy birthday from 1,200 miles away.
I asked Maya to hug you twice today. The second one is from me.
I set an alarm for 3 a.m. so I could be on time for your birthday. Worth every yawn.
Your present is a weekend, not a box: your city, my treat, you pick the dates.
Missing your birthday stings, and that’s how I know I picked the right best friend.
Happy birthday! Three things I love about you: your laugh, your loyalty and your terrible puns.
You make every room kinder. I hope today is as good to you as you are to everyone.
A year ago today we were singing off-key in your kitchen. Same plan tonight?
Happy birthday to the friend who always answers at 2 a.m. I owe you a lifetime of coffee.
I don’t say it enough: I’m so glad you’re in my life. Happy birthday.
Today is about you, and I hope you let it be. Big hug from me.
Still laughing about the road trip where we got lost for three hours. Best detour ever. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Dinner is on me this weekend, and you pick the place.
Remember the summer we painted your kitchen yellow? You laughed the whole time. That’s you. Happy 50th!
The day you drove two hours to help me move, I knew I had a friend for life. Happy 30th.
You taught me to make pancakes, to change a tire and to apologize first. Thank you, Dad. Happy 60th.
My favorite memory: that rainy night in Chicago when every restaurant was full and we ate pizza in the car.
You were the first person to read my resume and the first to celebrate when I got the job. Happy birthday.
Three words for you: brave, funny, home. Happy 40th from your oldest friend.
Happy birthday to the only person whose 12-minute voice memos I play all the way through. Keep them coming this year.
We’ve been long-distance friends longer than we lived ten minutes apart, and somehow we got closer. Happy birthday, you.
Something ridiculous happens here every week, and my first thought is always “wait till I tell you.” Happy birthday to my favorite audience.
Happy birthday to the friend who still knows my coffee order, my worst ex and my Wi-Fi password, all from three states away.
Happy birthday! I land in 42 days, and your belated birthday dinner is on me. Start picking the place.
Our booth at Rosie’s still feels wrong with one person in it. Happy birthday; the waitress asked about you again.
Happy birthday to my favorite three-hour phone call. Pick a night this week, and I’ll have snacks ready on my end.
Happy birthday to the one person I’d drive nine hours for. I have, twice, and I’d do it again tomorrow.
Same moon, two windows. Happy birthday from the other one.
Happy birthday to the best reason I know to take a red-eye flight.
Happy birthday, my love. The countdown on my lock screen says 19 days, and your present is me, waiting at arrivals.
You fell asleep on our call last night, and I stayed on another hour. That’s how gone I am. Happy birthday.
I miss the small stuff most: your cold feet, your one-person car concerts, the way you talk back to cooking shows. Happy birthday. I want all of it back soon.
You make long goodbyes and late-night calls worth it. Happy birthday. One day we won’t need either.
I hate missing your birthday. I love you more than I hate it, which is saying something. Happy birthday.
Here’s to this being the last birthday we spend in different cities. Happy birthday, love.
You raised me to be brave enough to move away, and you’ve answered every homesick call since. Happy birthday, Mom.
I still call you from the grocery store when I can’t tell if a melon is ripe. Happy birthday, Mom.
Happy birthday, Mom. I caught myself using your exact words with a friend last week, and for a second you were right here.
Your morning texts about the weather in my city are still my favorite alarm. Happy birthday, Dad.
Dad, the game isn’t the same without your play-by-play from the recliner. Happy birthday; I’ll call at halftime.
I’m home on the 14th, Dad, so get the fishing gear out of the garage. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, Dad. I timed this to land with your first cup of coffee. You taught me that showing up on time is its own way of saying I love you.
We still haven’t settled who started the backseat war on the 2004 road trip. Happy birthday; let’s argue about it on the phone tonight.
Growing up, we couldn’t get far enough apart. Now I’d share a bathroom with you again in a heartbeat. Almost. Happy birthday.
Our kids should know each other the way we knew our cousins. Let’s make it happen this summer. Happy birthday, sis.
You taught me to throw a spiral and to lose at Monopoly without crying. Happy birthday, bro. Rematch when I’m home.
Nobody else gets it when Mom sends one of her all-caps texts. I screenshot them all for you. Happy birthday.
Little brother, you’re a grown-up in a city I still haven’t visited, which is wild. Happy birthday. Send a photo of the candles, or it didn’t happen.
Your first birthday in a new city! I hope it already has a coffee shop that knows your order. Happy birthday.
The dog still pulls toward your old house on our morning walk. Happy birthday from the two of us.
Happy birthday to the bravest person I know. You packed up a whole life and started over, and I’m so proud of you.
I’ve already looked at flights, so tell me which weekend your guest room is free. Happy birthday!
Make a wish, then make a new friend, then call me and tell me everything about both. Happy birthday!
Trivia night has an empty chair now, and we’re losing without you. Happy birthday; come back and carry us soon.
You turned a year older while I was still eating lunch. Happy birthday from yesterday!
Happy birthday, Tía. The ocean between us is wide, but your Sunday calls make it feel small.
Happy birthday, Grandma! Fourteen of us are joining one call tonight just to sing to you, loudly and right on time.
It’s summer where you are and snowing here, which feels right: you always did bring the sunshine. Happy birthday!
We did the math: 5,400 miles and eight hours. Neither number makes us love you any less. Happy birthday, Uncle Raj.
Happy birthday, Grandpa! The kids drew you a cake to hold up on our call. It has a rainbow, three suns and your name spelled two different ways.
Missing you extra today. Happy birthday!
Far away, still front row. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday from afar! Close in every way that counts.
Wish I could hand-deliver this one. Happy birthday!
I’d be there in a heartbeat if hearts could fly coach. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Say hi to your cake for me.
Not there, but all in. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday from your biggest long-distance fan.
I’d send you a cake, but it would arrive as a pancake. Happy birthday anyway!
Happy birthday to the only face I enjoy watching freeze mid-sentence on a video call.
I wanted to surprise you in person, but my bank account said “send a text.” Happy birthday!
I’m singing to you right now. Be grateful for the 800 miles between you and my voice. Happy birthday!
Your card is somewhere between my mailbox and yours, probably sightseeing. Happy birthday in the meantime!
Happy birthday! I bought your favorite snack, opened it and ate the whole bag in your honor. You’re welcome.
I can’t make it tonight, but I’m RSVPing yes to the rest of your year. Happy birthday!
Here’s my toast, for whoever’s brave enough to read it out loud: to the funniest, kindest, worst-at-bowling person in the room. Happy birthday!
Since I’m missing your party, I’m throwing you a second one when I’m back. Guest list of two, dessert first.
I’ll be checking my phone all night, so post every photo, especially the bad ones. Have the best birthday.
I’m sorry I’ll miss the party. I’m not sorry I get you on the phone all to myself tomorrow.
So glad I get to work with you. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Hope today is all wins and no blockers.
Happy birthday! Thanks for being so easy to work with.
Happy birthday! You’re the best thing on today’s calendar.
Happy birthday! The only deadline today is cake.
Happy birthday to our go-to person for, well, everything.
Lucky us: another year with you on the team. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday to the reason our team chat is worth reading.
Wishing you a calm, cake-filled birthday. Enjoy every bite.
Happy birthday! I’ve booked a 30-minute meeting to discuss your cake. No agenda, cameras optional.
Per my last email: you’re great. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! May your password never expire and your laptop never restart mid-call.
Happy birthday! You’ve been promoted to Chief Cake Officer, effective immediately.
Happy birthday! I’d sing, but HR has asked me not to.
Let’s take this offline: there’s cake in the kitchen. Happy birthday!
You know where every file lives, which makes you essential. Happy birthday, and please never leave.
Happy birthday! I tried to plan a surprise party, but nobody’s calendar had a free slot.
Happy birthday! Your cake has been approved by legal, finance and the snack committee.
You turned this job into a place I actually look forward to. Thanks for being my person here. Happy birthday.
You were the first friendly face on my first day, and you’ve been my favorite part of the workday ever since. Happy birthday, friend.
Thank you for the stairwell pep talks, the honest feedback and the emergency chocolate. I’m better at this job, and happier, because of you. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday to my lunch buddy, my sounding board and the first person I tell when something goes right. May this year go right for you, again and again.
Some coworkers turn into friends you’d keep if you both quit tomorrow. You’re one of mine. Happy birthday.
You cheer for everyone else’s wins louder than your own, so today it’s my turn: you’re one of the good ones. Happy birthday.
Happy birthday, Tasha! I still share how you ran the fall launch as the example for new hires. Thank you for raising the bar for all of us.
Happy birthday! Watching you grow into this role has been one of the best parts of my year, and I’m excited for whatever you take on next.
You’re the person this team calls first when something breaks. Thank you for fixing things without ever making anyone feel small. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Manager’s orders: log off on time today and do something fun.
Happy birthday! The questions you ask in planning meetings make our work better. Please never stop asking them.
Happy birthday! I’m grateful every single day that you said yes to this team.
Clear answers, credit where it’s due and the benefit of the doubt: thank you for all three, and happy birthday!
You make it easy to bring you bad news early, and that’s the mark of a great boss. Happy birthday!
You guard our focus time like it’s sacred. We notice, and we’re grateful. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! May the only thing you have to approve today be dessert.
Here’s to a boss who sets a high bar and then helps us clear it. Happy birthday!
You opened a lot of doors for this team this year. Happy birthday, and thank you for every one of them.
Happy birthday from three time zones away! Seeing you pop up on our morning call always makes my day.
I can’t hand you a slice of cake, so here’s a virtual one and a very real thank-you. Happy birthday!
You’re on mute, but we can still tell you’re celebrating. Happy birthday!
To my favorite coworker I’ve never shared an elevator with: happy birthday!
You make a team spread across four cities feel like one room. Happy birthday!
When we finally meet in person, I owe you the biggest cupcake in town. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! We’re still learning how you take your coffee, but we already know we’re glad you’re here.
Happy first birthday on the team! Here’s to many more with us.
A new job and a birthday in the same month: here’s to both going brilliantly. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! Ask me anything this year, including where the good mugs are hidden.
It’s been a pleasure getting to know you these first few weeks. Happy birthday, and welcome to the team.
Happy birthday! You joined a good team, and you’re already making it better.
Happy belated birthday! My calendar let me down, but my appreciation for you is right on schedule.
Consider this the follow-up email: late, but it means well. Happy belated birthday!
Belated but sincere: happy birthday, and thanks for all you do around here.
This wish joins the list of things I should have sent on time, right under that expense report. Happy belated birthday!
I missed your birthday, so let me make it up to you: coffee this week, my treat, your choice of café.
Happy belated birthday! I hope the day was full of cake and the week since has been kind to you, too.
Happy 30th birthday! The way you’ve taken on bigger projects this year tells me the next ten years are going to be good ones.
Happy 40th! You bring calm, good judgment and the best lunch recommendations to this team. Here’s to everything still ahead.
Happy 50th! The team took a vote, and you’re the person we’d all want beside us in a crisis.
Happy 60th birthday! Every shortcut we use and every new hire who felt welcome here goes back to you.
Happy big birthday! The number is yours to share; the cake is ours to bring.
Happy milestone birthday! However you celebrate, we hope it’s as big, or as quiet, as you want.
Happy birthday! Today, do one thing just for you, then call me and tell me what it was.
Merry Christmas! You’re the best part of every December.
Wishing you a cozy Christmas and a new year full of good news.
Thank you for every laugh this year. Merry Christmas, with love.
Merry Christmas to my favorite person to text at midnight.
Thank you for showing up, every single time. Merry Christmas, friend.
Wishing you a Christmas as kind as you are.
Merry Christmas! Thanks for making the busy weeks feel lighter.
Enjoy the break, and don’t open your inbox once. Happy holidays!
Thank you for the help, the laughs and the coffee runs this year. Merry Christmas!
Merry Christmas! Thinking of you today and sending a big, warm hug.
Wishing you a peaceful Christmas full of good company and your favorite carols.
